Caged heap: kCagedHeapDefaultReservationSize = 4 * kGB; kCagedHeapMaxReservationSize = 1 << (31 + kPointerCompressionShift); shift = 3 under CPPGC_ENABLE_LARGER_CAGE (2^34 = 16 GiB) else 1.

HeapObjectHeader bitfields: padding 32 (64-bit only), GCInfoIndex 14, unused 1, in construction 1 ('In construction encoded as |false|'), size 15 ('17 bits because allocations are aligned', 0 = large object), mark bit 1; 'mark bit and in construction bits are located in separate 16-bit halves'.

Compression: Compress() shifts right by kPointerCompressionShift; Decompress() sign-extends to 64 bits, shifts left by the same shift, and ANDs the cage base — 'nullptr and the sentinel value do not have 1s in the base part and remain as-is' (v8/include/cppgc/internal/member-storage.h:131-179).
